refresh-interval.tooltip: How often the desklet re-fetches usage from the providers.

time-range.tooltip: The look-back window shown on the cards.

claude-enabled.tooltip: Fetch usage from the Anthropic Admin API.

claude-set-key.tooltip: Stores an Anthropic organization admin key (sk-ant-admin01-…) in the GNOME keyring.

claude-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Anthropic admin key from the keyring.

codex-enabled.tooltip: Fetch usage from the OpenAI Admin API.

codex-set-key.tooltip: Stores an OpenAI organization admin key in the GNOME keyring.

codex-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored OpenAI admin key from the keyring.

ollama-set-key.tooltip: Stores your ollama.com bearer key in the GNOME keyring.

ollama-clear-key.tooltip: Deletes the stored Ollama key from the keyring.
